[9:02PM] #Ogolonto #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is flowing smoothly from Aruna to Ogolonto and Itowolo via Aunty Kenny. 
The return journey to Majidun is also good, with minor delays near Ogolonto due to traffic alternation. 
However, approaching Agric is slow due to traffic navigating Ishawo road and commercial activities. 
The ferry terminal area is slightly congested at intersections, but traffic is moving. 
Ibeshe roundabout to Igbogbo is clear in both directions. 
Ojogbe and Ireshe road are busy due to traditional events, but traffic officers are on ground maintaining order.

#FollowLASTMA
